explanation: From main: forestReport.css restacks the gene page differential-expression rows and the pathway page forest rows under 640px so the change, q/FDR and study actions stay on a phone screen, and PathwayReport tags its axis header for that layout. From this branch: both reports follow the shared listing mode (ListingModeToggle above the gene table and beside the pathway headline). Gene report: in the p < 0.05 listing the table leads with FDR survivors by q then nominal tracks by p; in FDR mode with the FDR survivors by q, as before. Each row carries a data-tier and is labelled under its q (FDR < 0.05 or p < 0.05 only); the q in each cell is a hover-only QTerm, so the phone layout's CSS q prefix is dropped rather than doubled, and the legend's q is the keyboard-reachable one. Nominal rows show their p beside log2FC, uncoloured. Pathway report: each dataset block leads with its FDR survivors and, in the p < 0.05 listing, its nominal tracks; the DIR column becomes CALL with the shared TierLabel, in the same cell position the phone restack places; the FDR header and the legend explain q; block and category open state derive from the mode until the reader toggles them. SigPill, now unused, is removed and FOREST_GRID's last column widens. Significant counts, directions and colours follow the FDR call in both modes; contracts and routes are unchanged.
